title: Pablo Exclusive Passion Fruit Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Passion Fruit Nicotine Pouches offer a sharp, exotic flavour that balances tropical sweetness with a tangy edge. With 30mg of nicotine per pouch, it’s a strong and satisfying option for experienced users. Tobacco-free and vapour-free, each slim pouch is designed for comfort and discretion. Just tuck one under your upper lip and let it work its magic—no smoke, odour, or clean-up. This is one of the more unusual flavour profiles in the Pablo range, great for users who enjoy fruit-forward blends that deliver both taste and strength. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
